exposure: modified natural cycles (mNC) endometrium preparation regimen
cohort: 2186 pregnant women with singleton live births
finding: Programmed-FET cycles were associated with a higher occurrence of placental disorders, particularly abnormal placental attachment, compared to mNC-FET cycles and naturally conceived pregnancies.
mod_finding: Programmed frozen-thawed embryo transfer cycles were associated with a higher rate of Cesarean section compared to modified natural cycles or natural conception.
